blocks.text: Multi-hypenate Bela Padilla is stepping back from acting to build a mentorship program for aspiring writers, a career pivot made possible by years of strict financial discipline. Speaking with reporters on the sidelines of a recent media launch for a jewelry brand, the actres-writer-film producer admitted that she saved aggressively in her 20s. In fact, she joked that she still needs tips on how to actually reward herself.
